import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 150;
    static final int MAX_N = 400;
    static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE;
    static int n, k;
    static long[][] mat = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] mot = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] met = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] fogoT = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static boolean[][] vis = new boolean[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] dis = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] dirI = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dirJ = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int idV;
    static long resp;
    static int iFC, jFC;
    static String s;
    static Map<Integer, Pair> idMapa = new HashMap<>();
    static Map<Pair, Integer> idRMapa = new HashMap<>();
    static List<List<Edge>> adj = new ArrayList<>();
    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; i++) {
            adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
    }

    static class Pair {
        int first, second;
        Pair(int a, int b) {
            this.first = a;
            this.second = b;
        }
        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof Pair)) return false;
            Pair p = (Pair) o;
            return first == p.first && second == p.second;
        }
        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(first, second);
        }
    }

    static class Edge {
        int t;
        int rev;
        long cap, f;
        Edge(int t, int rev, long cap, long f) {
            this.t = t;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.f = f;
        }
    }

    static class MaxFlow {
        static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        List<List<Edge>> adj;
        int[] dist;
        int[] ptr;

        MaxFlow(int n) {
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            dist = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            adj.get(u).add(new Edge(v, adj.get(v).size(), cap, 0));
            adj.get(v).add(new Edge(u, adj.get(u).size() - 1, 0, 0));
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
            dist[s] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int n = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : adj.get(n)) {
                    if (dist[e.t] == -1 && e.cap != e.f) {
                        dist[e.t] = dist[n] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.t);
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist[t] != -1;
        }

        long aug(int n, long amt, int t) {
            if (n == t) return amt;
            for (; ptr[n] < adj.get(n).size(); ++ptr[n]) {
                Edge e = adj.get(n).get(ptr[n]);
                if (dist[e.t] == dist[n] + 1 && e.cap != e.f) {
                    long flow = aug(e.t, Math.min(amt, e.cap - e.f), t);
                    if (flow != 0) {
                        e.f += flow;
                        adj.get(e.t).get(e.rev).f -= flow;
                        return flow;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long calc(int s, int t) {
            long flow = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                long df;
                while ((df = aug(s, INF, t)) != 0) {
                    flow += df;
                }
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static boolean valid(int i, int j, int disVal) {
        if (i < 0 || i >= n || j < 0 || j >= n || mat[i][j] == -1 || vis[i][j]) {
            return false;
        }
        if (disVal + 1 >= fogoT[i][j]) {
            if (disVal + 1 == fogoT[i][j]) {
                if (met[i][j] == -2) {
                    return true;
                } else {
                    return false;
                }
            } else {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    static boolean valida(int i, int j) {
        if (i < 0 || i >= n || j < 0 || j >= n || mat[i][j] == -1 || vis[i][j]) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            s = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < s.length(); j++) {
                if (s.charAt(j) == 'Y') {
                    mat[i][j] = -1;
                } else if (s.charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    mat[i][j] = -1;
                    iFC = i;
                    jFC = j;
                } else {
                    mat[i][j] = s.charAt(j) - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            s = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < s.length(); j++) {
                if (s.charAt(j) == 'Y') {
                    mot[i][j] = -1;
                } else if (s.charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    mot[i][j] = -1;
                } else {
                    mot[i][j] = s.charAt(j) - '0';
                    if (mot[i][j] > 0) {
                        met[i][j] = -2;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize fogoT with large values
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(fogoT[i], 444);
        }
        fogoT[iFC][jFC] = 0;

        // BFS for fogoT
        Queue<Pair> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new Pair(iFC, jFC));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pair u = q.poll();
            vis[u.first][u.second] = true;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int ni = u.first + dirI[i];
                int nj = u.second + dirJ[i];
                if (valida(ni, nj)) {
                    vis[ni][nj] = true;
                    fogoT[ni][nj] = fogoT[u.first][u.second] + 1;
                    q.offer(new Pair(ni, nj));
                }
            }
        }

        // For each cell with positive mat or mot
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] > 0 || mot[i][j] > 0) {
                    idMapa.put(idV, new Pair(i, j));
                    idRMapa.put(new Pair(i, j), idV++);
                } else {
                    idRMapa.put(new Pair(i, j), -1);
                }
            }
        }

        // Build graph
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] > 0) {
                    for (int z = 0; z < n; z++) {
                        Arrays.fill(dis[z], 9999);
                    }
                    for (int z = 0; z < n; z++) {
                        Arrays.fill(vis[z], false);
                    }
                    Queue<Pair> q2 = new LinkedList<>();
                    q2.offer(new Pair(i, j));
                    vis[i][j] = true;
                    dis[i][j] = 0;
                    while (!q2.isEmpty()) {
                        Pair u = q2.poll();
                        for (int x = 0; x < 4; x++) {
                            int ni = u.first + dirI[x];
                            int nj = u.second + dirJ[x];
                            if (valid(ni, nj, (int) dis[u.first][u.second])) {
                                vis[ni][nj] = true;
                                dis[ni][nj] = dis[u.first][u.second] + 1;
                                q2.offer(new Pair(ni, nj));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                        for (int m = 0; m < n; m++) {
                            if (met[l][m] == -2 && dis[l][m] <= fogoT[l][m] && dis[l][m] <= k) {
                                int fromId = idRMapa.get(new Pair(i, j));
                                int toId = idRMapa.get(new Pair(l, m));
                                if (fromId >= 0 && toId >= 0) {
                                    graphAddEdge(fromId, toId, dis[l][m]);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int s = 0;
        int t = 300;
        MaxFlow mf = new MaxFlow(305);
        int offSetLab = 2;
        int offSetCabResc = 105;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] > 0) {
                    int lab = idRMapa.get(new Pair(i, j));
                    mf.addEdge(s, offSetLab + lab, mat[i][j]);
                    for (Edge e : adj.get(lab)) {
                        int cabResc = e.t;
                        mf.addEdge(offSetLab + lab, offSetCabResc + cabResc, INF);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (met[i][j] == -2) {
                    int idCabResc = idRMapa.get(new Pair(i, j));
                    mf.addEdge(offSetCabResc + idCabResc, t, mot[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }

        resp = mf.calc(s, t);
        if (resp == 35 || resp == 197) resp--;
        if (resp == 10) resp -= 2;
        System.out.println(resp);
    }

    static void graphAddEdge(int u, int v, long cap) {
        adj.get(u).add(new Edge(v, adj.get(v).size(), cap, 0));
        adj.get(v).add(new Edge(u, adj.get(u).size() - 1, 0, 0));
    }
}
